title: Code Names
about: The radio nicknames that became part of the crew's identity, presented through an old-fashioned intercom sound.
description: This track remembers the code names that took over the backstage radios during State Arts-In. What started as a joke became a shared language, with names like Crispy Kreme, Twinkie, Gold Leader, and Hawker carrying messages through booths, stairways, and green rooms. After the music was assembled, an old-fashioned intercom effect was applied to give the track the sound of those radio calls and reinforce the feeling of hearing the crew communicate through the building.
